title: unbacked_claim analyzer — comment/docstring claims a dependency never imported
intent: A comment or docstring says the code uses or falls back to a library, but that library is imported nowhere in the module, so the claimed path cannot exist. The purest failure-mimics-success shape: a capability claim in front of a same-shaped substitute. MAINT-DEFER-010: rayleigh_ritz.py carried '# Fallback to scipy if available' with no scipy imported; what ran was np.diag(K)/np.diag(M) with np.eye() mode shapes — a different calculation returning the same shape, silently. Detector C of three from the MAINT-DEFER triage.

scope.out_of_scope_notes: New analyzer only. Conceptually adjacent to name!=behavior but the mechanical signature is specific and cheap (a claim-shaped comment/docstring naming a known library whose import is absent). Symbol-level / return-shape dataflow is NOT attempted — HIGH-vs-MEDIUM keys on claim phrasing (fallback/if-available = HIGH silent-substitution; plain use = MEDIUM). baselines/main.json untouched: pure helpers at module scope, zero structural debt (fingerprint set verified identical). Detectors A and B shipped; the silencer-protocol note is a separate 4th branch.

what_changed: New UnbackedClaimAnalyzer (id unbacked_claim, version 1.0.0, rule UNBACKED_CLAIM_001): scans comments (tokenize) and docstrings (AST) for capability claims naming a known heavy/optional library, and fires when that library is imported nowhere in the module.

Severity: HIGH for fallback / if-available shapes (the silent-substitution case); MEDIUM for plain 'uses X' / 'X-based' claims. A mere prose mention ('faster than scipy') is not claim-shaped and stays silent.
Backed claims do not fire: imports are collected from the whole module AST (import / from-import, including try/except-guarded and function-local) plus importlib.import_module("lib") string args.
Known-libs set is heavy/optional compute libraries only (scipy, numba, torch, jax, sklearn, cython, cupy, dask, ...); numpy/pandas/requests are deliberately excluded to keep the signal clean.
Every failure mode is a Finding, never a raised exception: any internal error becomes a LOW UNBACKED_CLAIM_ERROR finding; unparseable files are skipped.

AnalyzerType.UNBACKED_CLAIM added; registered in api._DEFAULT_ANALYZERS; confidence_golden/confidence_policy/logic manifests refreshed for the new enum member (no version-anchor bump; order_dependence/hollow_guarantee precedent). Pure helpers at module scope so the analyzer adds zero new structural debt.
16 tests including the born-from-the-bug MAINT-DEFER-010 rayleigh_ritz fixture.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Distinct from exceptions (broad-except) and from the requirements/deployment analyzers (missing third-party install): this fires only on a first-person capability claim contradicted by the module's own imports. Adjacent to name!=behavior but a cheaper, precise mechanical signature.

commands_run: py -3.11 -m pytest tests/ -k "logic_manifest or golden or confidence_policy or registry_contract or version_bump or public_rules" -q
test_results: manifest/registry/version-bump contract tests: all passed after refresh.
Self-scan on src/ surfaced 0 findings (no false positives in the tool's own code).
verification.notes: Reads the real tree, no synthetic injection. Detector C of three; A and B shipped, each its own branch, held for triage.
